findings.title: next@14.2.5 vulnerable to CVE-2025-29927 (middleware auth bypass)
findings.evidence: Installed next@14.2.5 is below the fixed version 14.2.25 for the 14.x line. The x-middleware-subrequest header skips middleware entirely (GHSA-f82v-jwr5-mffw).
findings.impact: If auth is enforced only in middleware.ts (the dominant pattern in vibe-coded apps) and the app is self-hosted (not Vercel, which is auto-patched), this is a full authorization bypass.

findings.title: next@14.2.5 vulnerable to CVE-2025-55182/66478 "React2Shell" RSC RCE
findings.evidence: Installed next@14.2.5 is below the fixed version 14.2.35 for the 14.2 line (GHSA-9qr9-h5gf-34mp, CVSS 10, CISA KEV).
findings.impact: Remote code execution via React Server Components; affects nearly every App Router app on the vulnerable range.
findings.fix: Upgrade next to >= 14.2.35 (and react-server-dom-* to the matching fixed release).

findings.title: next@14.2.5 vulnerable to CVE-2026-44578 (WebSocket-upgrade SSRF)
findings.evidence: Installed next@14.2.5 falls in a vulnerable range for GHSA-c4j6-fc7j-m34r (CVSS 8.6).
findings.impact: Framework-level SSRF via WebSocket upgrade handling; self-hosted Node deployments only.
findings.fix: Upgrade next to >= 15.5.16 (15.x line) or >= 16.2.5 (16.x line).

findings.title: src.scan.rules.harvey-service-role-in-client: SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY is referenced in a module with no "server-only" import guard. If this module is ever imported from client code, the service-role key ships to the browser bundle — full RLS bypass for anyone who inspects it.

findings.title: 6 dependencies declared with an unpinned version range
findings.evidence: Unpinned: @supabase/supabase-js@^2.45.0, next@^14.2.5, pg@^8.12.0, react@^18.3.1, react-dom@^18.3.1, zod@^3.23.8.
findings.impact: A compromised upstream publish (or the next semver-compatible release) can land in installs without review, unless a lockfile is committed and enforced in CI.
findings.fix: Pin exact versions, or rely on a committed, CI-enforced lockfile (frozen install) as the actual pin.

findings.title: No lockfile found
findings.evidence: None of pnpm-lock.yaml, package-lock.json, yarn.lock present.
findings.impact: Every install can resolve different transitive versions — no reproducible, reviewable dependency tree.
findings.fix: Commit a lockfile and run installs with --frozen-lockfile / npm ci in CI.
